decision: Accepted locally for the bounded owner-reviewed lead-source integration slice; unpublished and not actual vendor delivery acceptance.
customerOutcome: An owner finds lead platforms in Connections, prepares the source-specific setup, receives a duplicate-safe inquiry with original context in the existing Inbox and takes the correct reviewed reply action without founder record edits.
acceptedScope: Angi: documented business ID/contact setup, retained generated endpoint/key, honest waiting-for-provider state, durable duplicate-safe Inbox intake, original project context and a saved draft/copy action with an explicit original-platform handoff.
Thumbtack: OAuth-first authorization, friendly authorized-business choice, automatic mock webhook preparation/verification, duplicate-safe source-aware Inbox intake and saved message history.
Thumbtack: an explicit owner-reviewed native reply retains its exact text and provider acceptance receipt separately from a customer read/contact outcome.
An uncertain native send remains visibly uncertain and cannot be blindly repeated by the ordinary UI or its status check.
A failed callback returns through the retained-session account resolver to the same workspace.
Lead sources precede the long core connection guides; prepared details, action feedback, source badges, external lead references and centered desktop/mobile dialogs were observed.

actualCustomerJobs.stage: Actual local frontend and access/client/Angi/Thumbtack/callback handlers, synthetic provider OAuth/API double, memory storage, zero physical network.

focusedFinalRender.stage: Three focused dialog geometry jobs at 320/390/1440 pixels and two plain-language configured/unconfigured Thumbtack renders. These are separate from the five customer jobs.

sourceBridge.explanation: The only final changes from accepted customer-job bytes are dialog margin:auto and two customer-facing reason replacements. Exact reverse substitutions recover the accepted hashes. Focused final renders observe those changes; no full journey rerun was required for these literal/style-only changes.

preservedFailureDisposition.r1: The early hidden platform details failure occurred while source changed and was returned to Engineering; the corrected actual contract was re-observed.
preservedFailureDisposition.r3: All four customer jobs passed, but the overall receipt retained two errors in the PO injection on a transient chrome-error document. The injection was scoped to the app origin; the original receipt is preserved.
preservedFailureDisposition.r4: Four customer jobs passed; callback-return proof failed because the PO fixture lacked the verified accounts/index projection. The actual ensureVerifiedAccount projection repaired the fixture, and r5 passed callback recovery. No application behavior was changed to satisfy this fixture failure.
